name: the mightstone and weakstone
mana cost: {5}
types: legendary artifact powerstone
activated[1]: {T}: add {C}{C}. this mana can't be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, choose one
option[2]: draw two cards.
option[3]: target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.

ALTERNATE

name: urza, planeswalker
types: legendary planeswalker urza
loyalty: 7
planeswalker[1]: [+2]: artifact, instant, and sorcery spells you cast this turn cost {2} less to cast. you gain 2 life.
planeswalker[2]: [+1]: draw two cards, then discard a card.
planeswalker[3]: [0]: create two 1/1 colorless soldier artifact creature tokens.
planeswalker[4]: [-3]: exile target nonland permanent.
planeswalker[5]: [-10]: artifacts and planeswalkers you control gain indestructible until end of turn. destroy all nonland permanents.
static: you may activate the loyalty abilities of CARDNAME twice each turn rather than only once.
replacement: CARDNAME enters with seven loyalty counters on it.
